item.title: Best budget smartphones: Pixel 10a and other top picks for performance, cameras, and battery life
item.description: Over the years, I went through my fair share of budget phones. I get why people complain about entry models. The processor drags. The camera misses. And the software… tests your patience. My Samsung Galaxy J8 gave me a hard time on the software side. I put up with slow speed and rough photos—my vacation shots still hurt to see. Apps wouldn’t open. The phone would freeze. It would restart on its own. Related: Apple’s March 4 event is mysterious—but should we be excited? Things look different now.
